english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person who takes part in sports.
For a person playing a sport, 運動員 is the all-purpose term rather than 播放器 or 玩家.

examples.english: The athlete took part in this charity run.
examples.traditional: 運動員參加咗今次慈善跑。
examples.jyutping: wan6 dung6 jyun4 caam1 gaa1 zo2 gam1 ci3 ci4 sin6 paau2

examples.english: I want to be a player on the school team.
examples.traditional: 我想做學校隊嘅運動員。
